notes:
Account snapshot: Veridatum builds an enterprise RAG platform for compliance teams at mid-large law firms and corporate legal depts. Primary need: searchable discovery + auditable reranking for responsiveness to regulatory requests. Heavy emphasis on VPC/private control plane, strict retention rules, and full audit trails.

Recent activity / timeline:
- 2025-02-12: Intro call (Avery) — requirement runbook requested. Customer: 'we need deterministic rerank behavior + retention policy enforcement'.
- 2025-02-14: Deep dive with infra + security (Diego) — discussed VPC peering, KMS options, HSM not required initially. Fireflies: ff_20250214_32ab9c-call.
- 2025-02-20: Architecture review (paper exercise) — proposed architecture: private control plane in customer VPC, dedicated GPU for index builds, snapshots to customer-controlled storage.
- 2025-02-21: Demo (Lena + Diego) — showed Redwood embeddings + rerank prototype on 50k docs; latency good but customer wants 99th percentile < 350ms at 50 qps. Fireflies: ff_20250221_77d2b6-demo.
- 2025-02-25: Sent SOW draft + security FAQ (drive links).
- 2025-02-28: Security team requested performance matrix for 100k/500k/1M docs and PKI/KMS integration steps.

Requirements summary (from security & search teams):
- Indexing scale: must support initial 500k documents, target 3M over 18 months; incremental updates daily.
- Query QPS target: 50 sustained, burst to 200. Latency SLO: median < 120ms, p95 < 300ms, p99 < 450ms for first-pass embedding retrieval; end-to-end (embedding + rerank) p99 target < 600ms.
- Cost constraints: looking to keep avg cost/query (including embeddings + rerank candidates) under $0.06 for typical inquiries; open to batching/quantization tradeoffs.
- Reranking: want deterministic, explainable rerank model (dense + lightweight cross-attention reranker). Audit logging must capture: query text, model id/version, rerank scores, timestamps, and user id for at least 7 years.
- Data residency: primary USA-only; no cross-border storage. Retention: retention policies per collection with legal-hold override.
- Security: SSO/SAML, SCIM for user provisioning, SOC2 compliance required, KMS-managed keys, immutable audit logs exported to customer SIEM.

POC scope (agreed):
- Duration: 2 weeks (prod-like environment in customer's VPC)
- Dataset: 500k-doc ingestion (mixed PDFs, OCRed images, MS Office)
- Workloads: 50 qps steady, scripted legal search tasks mimicking e-discovery runs
- Metrics to deliver: index build time, index storage size, avg tokens/embedding, retrieval latency distribution (median/p95/p99), rerank latency, cost per query estimate, audit log latency and retention verification.

Quotes and notes from stakeholders:
- Compliance lead: 'We cannot accept any opaque deletion flow — retention must be enforceable from control plane.'
- Head of Search: 'If Redwood can show predictable unit economics and p99 under 600ms at 50 qps we escalate to procurement.'

Next actions (short):
- Provision POC infra template + SOW finalization (Avery)
- Schedule kick-off with security (Diego + Lena) week of 2025-03-10
- Deliver perf projection and cost model for 500k/1M/3M indices by 2025-03-07
